description.en: OpenAI-completions-compatible LLM transport takeover for custom gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted proxies): always role:"system", thinking driven by the model config, thinking split on the receive side, multimodal true-send with a modality gate, and a prompt-source seam.
description.zh: 面向自建网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管代理）的 OpenAI-completions 兼容 LLM 适配器：固定使用 role:"system"，enable_thinking、chat_template_kwargs 与 reasoning_effort 由模型配置驱动，接收侧做思考段拆分。
